page.note: App outer background, no texture image needed

product_shadows.note: Photographic contact shadow retained inside food images. Additional CSS shadows apply to cards only.

illustration_background.note: All category gray circular pads, status dot, favorite hearts round buttons and badge are interface elements, not included in rasters.

text_policy: All labels, headings, prices, descriptions and numbers must be real HTML text, never baked into images.
positioning_note: screen pixels measured in 1448x1086 raster. Percentage calculations reference full screenshot.

published.note: Every asset URL is commit-pinned; manifest and guide will be in a later metadata commit.

transfer_notice: GitHub raster files were recompressed via a temporary AVIF intermediate and restored at 3x pixel dimensions; the downloadable local package retains higher quality WebP. Both are screenshot reconstructions.
